rows.question: How would I make this shape, using two pieces of paper, one black and one white, so that it looks like there is a white body with black wings?
rows.prediction:
To make a duck shape using two pieces of paper, one black and one white, you can follow these steps:

1. Start with a square or rectangular piece of paper, which will be the body of the duck.
2. Cut the square or rectangular paper in half, creating two triangles.
3. Fold one of the triangles in half along its length, creating a smaller triangle.
4. Fold the other triangle in half along its length, creating another smaller triangle.
5. Open the smaller triangles and place them on top of each other, with the folded edges aligned.
6. Fold the top triangle down, creating a point at the top.
7. Fold the bottom triangle up, creating a point at the bottom.
8. Fold the wings by folding the top triangle in half along its length, creating a smaller triangle.
9. Fold the wings in half, creating a smaller triangle.
10. Open the wings and place them on the body, with the folded edges aligned.

This will create a duck shape with a white body and black wings.
